title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the immediate surroundings of Augustana University in Sioux Falls, featuring local dining, study spots, and essential services within walking distance of campus.

cards.title: Big Poppa's Pizza
cards.subtitle: S Minnesota Ave
cards.notes: Visit this local spot for New York-style and Chicago-style deep dish pizza. Students and staff often receive a 25% discount on in-store orders.
cards.short_summary: A local pizzeria on S Minnesota Ave known for its diverse pizza styles and student-friendly discounts.
cards.evidence_claim: Augustana students and staff receive 25% off their order in store at Big Poppa's Pizza located at 2300 S Minnesota Ave.
cards.source_title: Hotel and Restaurant Partners - Sioux Falls - Augustana Athletics
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM (Sundays from 3:00 PM).

cards.title: Home2 Suites by Hilton
cards.subtitle: S Grange Ave
cards.notes: Located just blocks from campus, this hotel offers a specific Augustana rate for visiting families and university guests.
cards.short_summary: A convenient lodging option on S Grange Ave offering discounted rates for the Augustana community.
cards.evidence_claim: Home2 Suites at 1120 S. Grange Ave. is located blocks from the Augustana campus and offers an Augustana University discount.
cards.source_title: Lodging and Dining in Sioux Falls | Near Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Accessible 24/7 for guests; call directly to request the university rate.

cards.title: Campus Learning Center
cards.subtitle: W 33rd St
cards.notes: This licensed childcare facility serves the university and local community, providing age-appropriate education for toddlers and preschoolers.
cards.short_summary: A university-affiliated childcare center located on W 33rd St near the south edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The Campus Learning Center is located at Our Savior's Lutheran Church, 909 W. 33rd Street, and provides care for children ages 1-5.
cards.source_title: Campus Learning Center (Child Care) - Augustana University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:30 PM.

cards.title: Mr. Donuts
cards.subtitle: S Minnesota Ave
cards.notes: Stop by for fresh-made donuts daily and Vietnamese iced coffee. They offer 'buy 6 get 1 free' deals for a quick morning treat.
cards.short_summary: A locally owned donut and coffee shop on S Minnesota Ave popular for morning snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Mr. Donuts is located at 1100 S Minnesota Ave and offers fresh-made donuts daily and Vietnamese iced coffee.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; check for morning specials like free donuts with coffee purchase.

cards.title: Freedom Gas & Convenience
cards.subtitle: S Western Ave
cards.notes: This recently renovated Sinclair station provides grocery staples and fuel, serving as a convenient walking-distance shop for nearby residents.
cards.short_summary: A renovated convenience store and gas station on S Western Ave offering essential grocery items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Freedom location at 1801 S. Western Ave. is open daily from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m. and offers grocery staples.
cards.source_title: New owners revitalize central Sioux Falls gas station, convenience store
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Espinoza's Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: S Minnesota Ave
cards.notes: Enjoy authentic Mexican and Salvadorian flavors, including pupusas and street tacos, at this family-owned spot near campus.
cards.short_summary: A Mexican and Salvadorian restaurant on S Minnesota Ave known for traditional dishes.
cards.evidence_claim: Espinoza's Mexican Restaurant is located at 1200 S Minnesota Ave and serves traditional Mexican dishes and Salvadorian pupusas.
cards.source_title: Espinozas Mexican Restaurant: Authentic Mexican Restaurant
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; check website for current daily hours.

cards.title: Coffea Roasterie
cards.subtitle: S Phillips Ave
cards.notes: A popular downtown study spot for students, offering a modern aesthetic, freshly baked goods, and plenty of outlets for laptops.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary coffee shop in downtown Sioux Falls favored by students for studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Coffea Roasterie at 200 S. Phillips Ave. is highlighted as a study spot for students with indoor and outdoor seating.
cards.source_title: Cozy and caffeinated: 5 places to study off-campus - The Augustana Mirror
cards.access_notes: Open daily; popular for long study sessions during the academic year.

cards.title: Tre Lounge
cards.subtitle: W 33rd St
cards.notes: This neighborhood kitchen serves scratch-made dishes and offers catering services, located just south of the main campus area.
cards.short_summary: A local restaurant on W 33rd St offering a variety of scratch-made meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Tre Lounge is located at 601 W. 33rd St. and is known for its scratch-made dishes and catering concepts.
cards.access_notes: Check official website for current dining and lounge hours.

cards.title: Grille 26
cards.subtitle: S Western Ave
cards.notes: A contemporary dining spot offering a chef-inspired menu. It is a frequent choice for families visiting students on campus.
cards.short_summary: A casual contemporary restaurant on S Western Ave known for its diverse menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Grille 26 is located at 1716 S. Western Ave. and offers a casual contemporary dining experience.
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner daily.

cards.title: Foundation Heights
cards.subtitle: S Grange Ave
cards.notes: This new apartment complex on the northeast corner of campus provides modern suite-style living for upper-division students.
cards.short_summary: A new university-owned apartment building on S Grange Ave for student housing.
cards.evidence_claim: Foundation Heights is located on the northeast corner of 28th Street and Grange Avenue and will house more than 100 students.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to resident students; office spaces available on the first floor.
